## DRAFT — publication pending
Send one article or a batch. The batch step deduplicates delivery records, groups exact same-language headlines and records with a shared event or translation ID, and preserves every original language edition. Give trusted cross-language matches a shared event_id or a publisher-scoped translation_group_id.

The backend preparation endpoint currently returns 501. Connect licensed ingestion, persistent matching, evidence review and publication before activation. Use Header Auth credentials for both webhook and backend.

meta.description: Deduplicates incoming batches and keeps source editions by language. Persistent cross-batch matching, extraction and publication remain disabled.
